content.title: These restaurant chains have launched promos just in time for 4/20
content.text: April 20, 2026, 10:55 a.m. ETApril 20, also known as 4/20 or Weed Day, has long been celebrated as an unofficial holiday by marijuana smokers across the country.While theories vary regarding the celebration's origins, USA TODAY reports that it likely traces back to a group of teenagers hanging out after school in Marin County, California.Regardless, the date annually brings tons of discounts on THC- and CBD-infused products. Several restaurant chains are also rolling out limited-edition menu items and promotions in honor of the occasion.Blaze PizzaOn April 20, Blaze Pizza is offering a "BFF Bundle" for $25.99, according to USA TODAY. The online-only deal features two 11-inch pizzas, two fountain drinks, and two desserts. It is available online through the Blaze Pizza app or at blazepizza.com.BOGO at ChipotleWhile this next promotion celebrates a different occasion, Chipotle will be running a buy-one-get-one entrée deal on 4/20 as the Stanley Cup Playoffs get underway.On Monday, April 20, after 3 p.m. local time, fans who wear a hockey jersey to participating Chipotle locations can receive a BOGO entrée.Get baked with Insomnia Cookies and HostessIn honor of 4/20, Insomnia Cookies has rolled out a new limited-edition lineup of "munchie cookies created for insomniacs who know the best memories (and snacks) happen after dark."In collaboration with Hostess, the new cookies include:Cloud 9 Cravings Classic: A sugar cookie packed with cream cheese chunks, vanilla cake pieces, marshmallows, and a toasty butter crumble, topped with Hostess Twinkies snack cake.Strawberry Toastie Filled Classic: A buttery vanilla sugar cookie with strawberry filling topped with a strawberry toaster pastry.Insomnia rewards members can buy four Classic cookies and get two Classic cookies free through April 20.Jimmy John's 'Dream Rotation' menuJimmy John's has launched a limited-time Dream Rotation Menu, offering customers the "ultimate post-sesh" meal, including a toasted sandwich, a bag of chips and the new Cereal n' Milk Crispy Treat.JJ's fans can build their own meal or choose from one of four curated options in collaboration with celebrities such as Cheech Marin and Kal Penn.On April 20, JJ's Rewards members can buy one Dream Rotation Meal, get one free with the promo code "DREAMROTATION."Red LobsterRed Lobster is cooking up something special this year, teasing a 4/20 drop on social media ahead of the unofficial holiday. In an Instagram post on April 16, the company shared an image of "4.20" on a backdrop of shrimp, accompanied by the caption, "What do you think we're dropping next week?"Fans were still eagerly awaiting the company's announcement as of 10 a.m. April 20.Last year, Red Lobster celebrated 4/20 with a special $4.20 cocktail.Wingstop brings back the Hot BoxWingstop is celebrating 4/20 with the return of its fan-favorite Wingstop Hot Box.This meal features either three tenders or eight wings tossed in Fiery Nacho seasoning and served on a bed of fries. The food is topped with a drizzle of house-made ranch and finished with an herb seasoning. Each box also includes a drink and a side dip of your choice.
